name: settings-migrate
note: A settings file as 1.9.2 or older left it (no settings_version), with the ray tracing quality the old menus offered (2, High, their default), the game started without the launcher: at its start the quality is set to 3, path traced, the default since Ray tracing became the path traced lighting, and the file saved at once with settings_version 1, the other settings and the keys the game does not know kept (src/common/settings_version.h).

expect: found(runlog, r'settings: castlevania.toml from an older release \(settings_version 0\).*ray_tracing_quality 2 to 3')
